purpose: Define the independent holdout requirements before any formal Candidate 2 model execution.
execution_order: Freeze corpus, queries, labels, manifest, Candidate 2 policy, and unchanged Phase 3F promotion thresholds in git.
Certify the freeze commit without running Candidate 2 on the holdout.
Enable holdout execution in a later enable-only commit that changes no holdout data, labels, thresholds, model identity, or ranking algorithm.
Measure holdout hybrid baseline and Candidate Recall@10 on the exact frozen holdout.
Run Candidate 2 on the same exact holdout and evaluate against the holdout baseline.
If quality-bearing data, labels, thresholds, model identity, or ranking logic changes after results are observed, burn the holdout and author a new one.
